summary: Control Room Phase 1 tested end-to-end (backend pytest 14 tests + Playwright UI on desktop/mobile). CRITICAL bug found and FIXED by tester: Stripe Checkout creation failed for every purchase (Stripe 400 'product tax code is missing ... Managed Payments') -> API returned 502 (shown to the browser as a Cloudflare HTML page). I added tax_code 'txcd_10103001' + managed_payments={'enabled': False} to controlroom.py, matching the credits checkout in server.py. After the fix: checkout works (line 'CONTROL ROOM — 119,00 € / EVENTO', description 'Evento: <nome>', unit_amount 11900, IVA 22% -> 145,18 €, mode payment). When you check out again, earlier pending purchases become expired. Admin-only works (staff gets 403). A cross-org event returns 404. Missing billing data returns 400. An unpaid confirmation stays pending. A cross-org session_id returns 403. An unsigned webhook returns 400. Activation logic checked by calling controlroom.build handlers directly with motor: unpaid stays pending, tampered metadata is ignored, a paid session activates once (audit runs once), a second paid purchase becomes duplicate_paid, a partial refund is ignored, a full refund sets refunded, and an unrelated charge falls through to PARTNER. An active purchase gives status active and a new checkout returns 409. 13/14 pass; the remaining failure: an invalid session_id gives 500. UI: the sidebar shows Control Room directly below Staff / Volontari. Marketplace card and dialog show the right price and mode, the not-included-in-subscription text, and the CTA to /control-room. Event Map 29 €/anno and Event Planner 'Da 29 €/mese' unchanged. /control-room: event selector, ATTIVA CONTROL ROOM redirects to Stripe, staff sees the admin-only message, demo admin with no events sees the Eventi link, and the active state shows the placeholder card. The homepage section and the public /funzionalita/control-room page are correct. No horizontal overflow at 390px.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: Stripe rejected the session because tax_code was missing (Managed Payments is on by default on this account), so every purchase returned 502. Added product_data.tax_code='txcd_10103001' and managed_payments={'enabled': False} (same pattern as credits checkout). Please review and keep.

minor.issue: Unhandled stripe InvalidRequestError -> 500. Wrap Session.retrieve in try/except StripeError -> 404/400.
No invoice_creation (addons checkout uses invoice_creation enabled). A paid 119 € + IVA purchase creates no Stripe invoice/fattura record. Check whether the invoices/FIC flow needs it.
controlroom_purchases is not in ORG_CASCADE_COLLECTIONS, so purchases are left orphaned when an org is deleted.

These use user['org_id'] directly, while checkout uses require_admin (which resolves the active org via _resolve_active_org). Multi-org/membership users may see a different org than the one they buy for.

ui_bugs.issue: The button is disabled while ev.pending is true. If the user cancels or abandons Stripe Checkout (cancel_url ?canceled=1), the purchase stays 'pending' until Stripe expires the session (~24h). The ATTIVA button stays disabled, so the user cannot retry, even though the backend supports re-checkout (it expires the earlier pending purchases). Fix: keep the button enabled when pending, or expire the pending purchase on cancel.

integration_issues.issue: The 'Pagamento annullato' toast appears twice (useEffect runs twice / StrictMode).

issues: Adaptive Pricing makes USD the default currency (165,97 USD) instead of EUR. This is a Stripe account setting and may also affect other checkouts.
If GET /controlroom/events fails, the catch sets events=[], so the page wrongly shows 'Crea prima un evento' instead of an error state.

action_items: Keep/review tester fix in controlroom.py checkout (tax_code + managed_payments disabled)
Do not disable ATTIVA CONTROL ROOM when pending (or expire pending on canceled=1) so users can retry after cancelling
Consider invoice_creation for the Control Room payment (fattura)
Use the resolved active org consistently in /controlroom/events and /status
critical_code_review_comments: _activate correctly requires status=complete and payment_status=paid, checks metadata org/event against the stored purchase, and is idempotent via conditional update_one.

In stripe_webhook, charge.refunded runs CONTROL_ROOM.on_refund before PARTNER.on_refund. on_refund ignores partial refunds (refunded=false). Fine for Phase 1, but partial refunds keep the purchase active.
require_active is exported but not used yet (expected for Phase 2).

success_rate.backend: 93% (13/14) after tester fix; 0% of checkouts worked before fix

seed_data_creation: None persisted. TEST_CR / TEST_CRUI orgs, events, staff users and all controlroom_purchases were deleted by id. One pytest run left 2 detached admin users (test_cr_a_/b_) despite the teardown; I deleted them by exact email. Stripe test customers/sessions remain in the Stripe sandbox.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_controlroom_phase1.py -n0 (module-scoped fixture, needs serial). UI setup: python tests/ui_controlroom_setup.py, then 'cleanup' (writes /tmp/ui_cr.json). Staff users inserted directly need telefono + accepted_terms_at, or they are redirected to /completa-profilo. Dismiss the cookie banner ('Reject non-essential') and the demo modal ('Non ora') before clicking. Retest the pending-button retry and the confirmation 500.
